text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Scarlet! I beat ya! Guess that 
makes me the queen now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that's right... Well, that settles 
it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Waaait! We had a deal, remember? The loser 
has to do whatever the Queen says.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... How humiliating. To think it 
would come to this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, Trainer, you can order this guy 
to do anything. Tell him something crazy.

choice_data_list: I want you to shower me with praise

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sing your praises? A-Alright, fine... Well 
then...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you really are amazing. To 
actually beat me in the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you some kind of genius? I kinda... 
respect that...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! This is fine, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, my turn next. Let's see here...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you try saying, "Vodka-san, 
you're number one. I'm just a nobody who's 
second rate or worse"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-What did you say~?! Grrr, grrr, 
grrrrgh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, who is it? Come on, come on, spit it 
out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The one who pisses me off the most is you! 
You're the absolute worst, most 
infuriating jerk ever!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? That's not what we agreed on, hey!

For a while, the two bickered animatedly 
under the watchful eyes of the onlookers.
